title: Beatrix was great!...
text: Beatrix was great! Knowledgable, funny, great guide for our day walking around Sevilla. Can’t recommend her enough!
author: brandon_M

title: A must to begin to know Sevilla
text: If you want in depth about the history and cultural significance behind Sevilla, this is absolutely the way to go — without a doubt. Our guide is passionate about Sevilla and it showed. With a short amount of time we are spending here we are grateful to have met such a guide to share the city with and learn about the beautiful people, the food,  the architecture and the rich history. We also picked up tips on where to go and what else to see if we had time. Very much appreciated!
author: Jeffrey_P

title: Excellent guide
text: The tour hit all the highlights and the tour guide was exceptionally good. Beatrice was the hit of the show. Her warmth and knowledge of Seville and her attention to our needs made it a memorable day.
author: Ross_G

title: Full day in Seville under the scorching heat was pleasant thanks to Beatriz.
text: Beatriz was very energetic, positive, kind, passionate in her role as tour guide. One can easily tell she definitely loves her job. She is very knowledgeable and super accommodating. She wanted to make sure she answered all of our questions (4 of us) and was willing to take us to an unplanned place as we walked by and saw it (archive museum.)  Beatriz is super lovely and this made our day so enjoyable while learning new things in Seville. We were like friends toward the end of the tour. We definitely recommend people to look at her web page at BeatrizPerezGarcia.com to check out her services.
author: HUAN T

title: Exceptional!!!!
text: We had a wonderful day with Bea ( Beatriz), she was very enthusiastic from the start to the finish. You could tell she loves her job! We are lovers of history and we enjoyed her enthusiasm! She gave us a full day of everything that we wanted to see (and more).  She aldo helped us with our Spanish food choices for lunch and even wine! We invited her to eat lunch with us and it was absolutely a wonderful addition to our full day private tour. I would not hesitate to do this again! Fabulous , fabulous day!!!!
author: Bonnie_G

title: Great tour of the city!
text: Great tour of the city. Beatriz was very knowledgeable and kind. You get to see the key landmarks and learn about the city history

title: Excellent!
text: We had a wonderful time with Beatrice today.   She has a wonderful personality and provided us such a detailed educational tour.  We learned so much today. She answered all our questions.   She is kind and very flexible and accommodated our needs.  Thank you Beatrice for providing us a wonderful experience.   We definitely will recommend the tour to our family and friends.   We look forward to coming to Seville agian soon.  Such a beautiful city, the people, culture and safety ❤️
author: cillak2025

title: Tour guide made the difference
text: We learned so much about Seville. Our tour guide, Beatriz, was excellent!  She explained the history of the city and Spain during the walking tour and told wonderful stories about the historical period. The Alcázar and cathedral were incredible and Beatriz  pointed out details that we would have missed if we had not been with her. Overall, she made the tour fun and interesting and we were super grateful that she was our guide. Highly recommend this tour and I hope your are lucky enough to have Beatriz as your guide!
